itinerary.title: Camel Desert Trek from M’Hamid to Lahnanich Dunes
itinerary.description:
Your Sahara camel trek begins in M’Hamid, where we leave our oasis camp and start walking toward the beautiful Lahnanich sand dunes. The journey takes you across a wide and peaceful Sahara desert plateau, surrounded by open landscapes and the quiet beauty of the desert.

After a day of trekking, we reach the heart of the dunes where we set up our desert camp. As the sun begins to set, enjoy a traditional Sahara tea ceremony on top of the dunes, followed by a delicious Moroccan tajine prepared by our local team.

Spend the night in a traditional desert tent or sleep under the stars, surrounded by the silence of the Sahara.

This is more than a camel trek it is a chance to slow down, connect with nature, and experience the Moroccan Sahara through the eyes of a local nomadic family.

itinerary.title: Continue Your Sahara Camel Trek
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, your camel trekking adventure continues deeper into the Sahara Desert, crossing the peaceful dunes and open desert landscapes. Take your time to enjoy the scenery, the silence, and the unique atmosphere of the Moroccan Sahara.

In the afternoon, return to our Oasis Camp in M’Hamid, where you can relax and enjoy a well-deserved shower after your desert adventure. In the evening, enjoy a traditional dinner and spend the night at the camp.

The following morning, wake up to a peaceful desert atmosphere and enjoy breakfast at our camp. After breakfast, we arrange your transfer back to M’Hamid center, marking the end of your Sahara camel trekking experience.

A simple, authentic desert journey walking the dunes, sharing traditional moments, and experiencing the Sahara at your own pace.

items.subtitle: A short camel-supported introduction to the dunes
items.title: 2 Days Sahara Desert Trekking Morocco
items.overview:
Experience an authentic 2-day Sahara Desert trekking adventure in southern Morocco, guided by a local nomadic guide and camel handlers who know the desert from generations of experience. Walk through the golden dunes at your own pace while camels carry your luggage, giving you the freedom to fully enjoy the peaceful landscapes.

Discover the silence and beauty of the Sahara, meet local nomadic communities, enjoy spectacular sunrises and sunsets, and experience traditional desert life. Along the way, your camel handlers prepare fresh Moroccan meals, traditional bread baked in the sand, and tea over the fire. At night, sleep in a desert camp or under the stars and enjoy the incredible atmosphere of the Sahara.

This 2-day Sahara trek is available from mid-September to mid-May and can start with just two participants. The itinerary is fully private, flexible, and customizable, allowing you to choose your preferred travel date and adapt the experience to your needs.

Walk the Sahara, meet its people, and experience the desert the way it has been lived for generations.

itinerary.title: MARRAKECH – M’HAMID
itinerary.description: Begin your Sahara adventure with a scenic drive from Marrakech to M’Hamid, crossing the dramatic Tiffernine Mountains and Saghro massif. Continue through the spectacular Drâa Valley, surrounded by palm groves, ancient kasbahs, and traditional villages. Upon arrival in M’Hamid, meet your camel team before heading into the desert for your first night under the stars, with dinner at the bivouac.

itinerary.title: M’Hamid – Erg Sahal
itinerary.description: Set off from M’Hamid with your camel caravan towards Erg Sahal, crossing the dry Drâa River and traveling through a peaceful landscape of sand, rocky plains, and tamarisk trees. Along the way, enjoy wide desert views with the Lakrab Mountains and Drâa Hamada appearing on the horizon. A beautiful day of trekking through the quiet and untouched Sahara.

itinerary.title: M’Hamid – Marrakech
itinerary.description: After breakfast, begin your journey back to Marrakech, leaving the peaceful Sahara behind. Enjoy a lunch break along the way before continuing through the beautiful landscapes of southern Morocco. Arrive in Marrakech in the afternoon, marking the end of your desert adventure.

items.subtitle: Three days of walking and camping with a camel caravan
items.title: 3 Days Sahara Desert Trekking Morocco
items.overview:
Experience the magic of the Moroccan Sahara on a 3-day trek through the golden dunes of M’Hamid. Accompanied by local nomadic guides and camels carrying your luggage, you’ll walk at a relaxed pace, discover the peaceful desert landscape, and enjoy unforgettable sunsets and sunrises.

Spend your nights under the stars or in traditional desert tents, enjoy freshly prepared Moroccan meals, traditional tea, and bread baked in the sand. It’s a simple, authentic adventure designed to disconnect from everyday life and reconnect with the beauty and silence of the Sahara.

Available from mid-September to mid-May, with departures from just 2 people.

itinerary.title: Marrakech – Ouled Driss
itinerary.description: Depart early from Marrakech and cross the spectacular Tichka Pass at 2,260 meters before descending into the beautiful Drâa Valley, known for its ancient kasbahs and fortified villages. Continue towards Ouled Driss, where you’ll meet the camel handlers and begin your Sahara adventure. Enjoy dinner and your first night in a traditional desert tent. Approximately 450 km covered.

itinerary.title: Ouled Driss – Lahnaniche Dunes
itinerary.description: Begin your trek towards the beautiful Lahnaniche Dunes, crossing a vast desert plateau surrounded by peaceful landscapes. Along the way, discover an ancient kasbah and old houses that reflect the region’s rich history. Enjoy lunch in the shade of tamarisk trees before continuing your trek to the desert camp. After around 5 hours of walking, arrive at the Lahnaniche Dunes for a relaxing evening in the Sahara.

itinerary.title: Lahnaniche – Ras Nkhal
itinerary.description: After breakfast, continue your trek through the golden dunes of the Erg, enjoying the peaceful beauty of the Sahara. Stop for a traditional lunch prepared by your cook in the shade of palm trees. In the afternoon, continue towards Ras Nkhal, near M’Hamid and its palm groves, where you’ll set up camp for the night. Relax under a traditional tent or sleep beneath the stars after around 5.5 hours of walking.

itinerary.title: Ras Nkhal – Zagora – Ouarzazate – Marrakech
itinerary.description: After breakfast, begin your journey back to Marrakech, with a stop in Tamegroute to discover its traditional pottery and historic Quranic library. Continue through Zagora and Ouarzazate, enjoying the beautiful landscapes of southern Morocco, with a lunch stop along the way. Arrive in Marrakech in the late afternoon, marking the end of your Sahara adventure.

items.title: 4 Days Sahara Desert Trekking Morocco
items.overview:
Discover the peaceful beauty of the Moroccan Sahara on a 4-day trek through the golden dunes around M’Hamid. Accompanied by local nomadic guides and camel handlers, you’ll travel at a relaxed pace while camels carry your luggage and equipment.

Experience the silence of the desert, meet local nomads, enjoy traditional Moroccan meals, and watch spectacular sunsets and sunrises. Nights are spent in traditional bivouacs under the stars, with fresh tea, bread baked in the sand, and the simple rhythm of desert life.

itinerary.title: Marrakech – M’Hamid
itinerary.description: Depart from Marrakech in the morning and travel through the scenic Tiffernine Mountains and across the Saghro massif via the Tizi n’Tinififft Pass. Continue through the beautiful Drâa Valley, surrounded by ancient kasbahs and fortified villages, until reaching M’Hamid. Meet your camel handlers before heading into the desert for your first night in a traditional bivouac, with dinner and an authentic Sahara atmosphere.

itinerary.title: M’Hamid – Erg Bouzian
itinerary.description: Begin your desert trek from M’Hamid towards Erg Bouzian, crossing the dry Drâa River and traveling through wide sandy and rocky plains dotted with tamarisk trees. Enjoy the peaceful desert scenery as the Lakrab Mountains and the Drâa Hamada appear on the horizon. Continue with your camel caravan through the untouched landscapes of the Sahara and settle into the desert camp for the night.

itinerary.title: Erg Bouzian – Rass Errich
itinerary.description: Continue your desert journey towards Rass Errich, crossing peaceful and untouched landscapes dotted with acacia trees. As you approach the dunes, take time to admire the spectacular Sahara sunset before settling into your desert camp for a magical night beneath the stars.

itinerary.title: Rass Errich – M’Hamid
itinerary.description: Continue your trek across the golden dunes and vast desert plateaus towards the palm groves of M’Hamid. Upon arrival, take some time to relax and enjoy a refreshing shower. In the evening, enjoy dinner and spend another peaceful night in the desert.

itinerary.title: M’Hamid – Marrakech
itinerary.description: After breakfast, begin your journey back to Marrakech, leaving the peaceful Sahara behind. Enjoy a lunch stop along the way while taking in the changing landscapes of southern Morocco. Continue the drive and arrive in Marrakech in the afternoon, marking the end of your Sahara adventure.

items.title: 6 Days Camel Trek Zagora Sahara Desert Nomadic Adventure
items.overview: A six-day nomadic adventure from the Zagora region, combining walking or camel riding with traditional desert camps and local Sahrawi hospitality.

itinerary.title: Marrakech – M’Hamid
itinerary.description: Depart from Marrakech in the morning and cross the High Atlas Mountains via the Tizi-n-Tichka Pass. Continue through the Tiffernine Mountains and the Saghro massif via the Tizi n’Tinififft Pass, before descending into the beautiful Drâa Valley, surrounded by ancient kasbahs and fortified villages. Arrive in M’Hamid, meet your camel handlers, and begin your Sahara adventure with dinner and an overnight stay in the desert.

itinerary.title: M’Hamid – Sidi Naji
itinerary.description: After breakfast, begin your trek towards Sidi Naji, crossing a beautiful desert landscape of golden dunes and rocky plains dotted with tamarisk trees. Along the way, enjoy views of the Kraab mountain range and the peaceful surroundings of the Sahara. End the day by settling into a traditional bivouac among the dunes for a relaxing night in the desert.

itinerary.title: Sidi Naji – Erg Zahar
itinerary.description: Continue your Sahara adventure towards the impressive dunes of Erg Zahar, traveling through a vast sandy landscape. Upon arrival, take the opportunity to climb one of the region’s highest dunes and enjoy breathtaking views across the desert. In the evening, settle into your bivouac at the foot of the dunes and enjoy a peaceful night in the heart of the Sahara.

itinerary.title: Erg Zahar – Creatjmal
itinerary.description: Continue your trek through the beautiful dune landscape of Erg Zahar, where golden sands meet scattered tamarisk trees and the Oued Drâa. Enjoy the peaceful scenery as you make your way towards Creatjmal, where your bivouac will be set up for another relaxing night in the Sahara.

itinerary.title: Creatjmal – Bertam
itinerary.description: Start the day by enjoying the peaceful landscapes of Oued Naam, then stop for lunch beneath the shade of large tamarisk trees. In the afternoon, continue your trek through the smaller dunes towards Bertam. Settle into your bivouac among the dunes and enjoy another quiet evening in the Sahara.

itinerary.title: Bertam – M’Hamid
itinerary.description: Continue your trek through the peaceful landscape of smaller dunes on the way back to M’Hamid. After a long day of walking, arrive in M’Hamid in the late afternoon, where you can relax and enjoy a refreshing shower. End the day with dinner and another night in the desert.

itinerary.title: M’Hamid – Marrakech
itinerary.description: After breakfast, begin your journey back to Marrakech, leaving the peaceful Sahara behind. Enjoy a lunch stop along the way and take in the changing landscapes of southern Morocco. Continue the drive towards Marrakech and arrive in the afternoon, marking the end of your 7-day Sahara trekking adventure.

items.subtitle: A week-long camel-supported journey into the Great Sahara
items.title: 7 Days Sahara Desert Trekking Morocco
items.overview:
Immerse yourself in the beauty and silence of the Moroccan Sahara on a 7-day trekking adventure through vast golden dunes and remote desert landscapes. Accompanied by local nomadic guides and camel handlers, you’ll travel at a relaxed pace while camels carry your luggage and equipment.

Discover traditional desert life, encounter local nomads, and experience the unique plants and wildlife of the Sahara. Enjoy breathtaking sunrises and sunsets, freshly prepared Moroccan cuisine, traditional tea, and bread baked in the sand.

Spend peaceful nights in traditional desert bivouacs or beneath the stars, following the natural rhythm of the sun and enjoying a true escape from everyday life.

Available from mid-September to mid-May, with departures from just 2 participants on the date of your choice.
included: Tea and bread baked in the sand

itinerary.title: MARRAKECH – DJINEYA (ZAGORA)
itinerary.description:
In the morning, depart from Marrakech and travel towards M’Hamid. The journey takes you across the Atlas Mountains via the Tizi-n-Tichka Pass, then through the Tiffernine Mountains and across the Saghro Massif via the Tizi n’Tinififft Pass.

Continue through the beautiful Drâa Valley, famous for its palm groves, ksours (fortified villages), and traditional kasbahs, before reaching the Zagora region.

In Djineya, you will meet your local camel handlers and begin your Sahara desert adventure. Enjoy dinner and spend your first night in a traditional desert bivouac

itinerary.title: DJINEYA – OASIS OUM LILI – LBOUDIAT
itinerary.description:
Start the day in the cool morning air by crossing the Djebel Bani through the Djineya Pass. Enjoy panoramic views over the beautiful Drâa Valley, with its lush green palm groves stretching through the desert landscape.

After a midday break to rest and enjoy lunch, continue the trek towards the Oasis of Oum Lili, where you can discover the contrast between the green oasis and the surrounding arid desert.

Continue walking to Lboudiat, where the traditional desert bivouac will be set up for the night. Enjoy a peaceful evening in the Sahara, surrounded by the silence and beauty of the desert.

itinerary.title: LBOUDIAT – HASSI NAANAA – STILLA
itinerary.description:
In the morning, leave Lboudiat and continue your trek across a vast hamada, a rocky desert plateau dotted with acacia trees. Enjoy the peaceful scenery and the rugged beauty of the Sahara as you make your way towards Hassi Naanaa.

After a midday break to rest and enjoy lunch, continue walking through the impressive Bani Mountains. By the end of the day, arrive at Stilla, where you will set up the desert bivouac and spend the night under the peaceful Sahara sky.

itinerary.title: STILLA – OUED LGHAREG
itinerary.description:
Head south from Stilla into the vast desert plateaus surrounding the Bani Mountains. Continue your trek through the striking black stone desert, where the rugged landscape offers a unique contrast to the golden dunes of the Sahara.

Take your time to enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and spectacular desert scenery before continuing towards Oued Lghareg.

At the end of the day, set up the desert bivouac at Oued Lghareg, where you will enjoy dinner and spend a peaceful night under the stars.

itinerary.title: Camp life
itinerary.description:
Over these two days, continue your Sahara trekking journey with the camel caravan through a changing desert landscape of sand dunes, rocky plains, and tamarisk trees.

From Oued Lghareg, the caravan makes its way towards Oued Laatach, then continues through Bougerne before reaching Oued Naam. The route offers a peaceful and remote desert experience, with wide-open landscapes and little sign of modern civilization.

Oued Naam was once known for its population of ostriches, which is reflected in its name. Enjoy the tranquility of this untouched part of the Sahara, with time to rest, observe the landscape, and experience traditional desert life.

At the end of each day, the camel handlers prepare the bivouac, dinner, and a comfortable night in the heart of the Sahara.

itinerary.title: OUED NAAM – M’HAMID
itinerary.description:
Depart from Oued Naam and continue your trek across the Hamada du Drâa, a vast and remote stony desert known as a reg, scattered with dark volcanic stones and surrounded by impressive desert landscapes.

Continue walking through this peaceful and untouched environment as the caravan gradually makes its way towards M’Hamid. Arrive in M’Hamid in the late afternoon, where you can relax, enjoy a well-earned shower, and take some time to rest after the day's trek.

In the evening, enjoy a traditional Moroccan dinner and spend the night in the desert bivouac, surrounded by the peaceful atmosphere of the Sahara.

itinerary.title: M’HAMID – MARRAKECH
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, say goodbye to the Sahara and begin your return journey from M’Hamid to Marrakech. Travel through the landscapes of southern Morocco with a lunch stop along the way.

Continue the journey towards Marrakech and arrive in the afternoon, marking the end of your 8-day Sahara Desert trekking adventure.

items.subtitle: An eight-day immersion in the Moroccan Sahara
items.title: 8 Days Sahara Desert Trekking Morocco

Enjoy an authentic 8-day Sahara Desert Trekking adventure in Morocco, walking through the vast dunes and peaceful landscapes of southern Morocco with a local nomadic guide and camel handlers.

A caravan of camels carries your luggage while you explore the desert at your own pace. Discover nomadic traditions, meet local people, enjoy traditional Moroccan meals, fresh bread and mint tea prepared in the desert, and experience unforgettable sunsets and sunrises.

Each night, sleep in a traditional desert tent or under the stars and enjoy the silence and beauty of the Sahara. This trek is perfect for travelers looking to disconnect from everyday life and experience the Moroccan desert in an authentic way.

Available from mid-September to mid-May, with flexible private departures for a minimum of 2 participants.

itinerary.title: M’Hamid El Ghizlane – Sacred Oasis – Erg Chigaga
itinerary.description:
Start your Sahara adventure in M’Hamid El Ghizlane, the gateway to the Moroccan desert. Travel by 4x4 across rocky plains, dry riverbeds, and beautiful desert landscapes.

Along the way, stop at the peaceful Sacred Oasis, where tamarisk trees create a quiet place in the middle of the desert.

Continue towards the impressive Erg Chigaga dunes and arrive at your desert camp in the afternoon. Enjoy a traditional mint tea and take some time to relax and discover the dunes.

As the sun sets, enjoy a camel ride across the golden sand. In the evening, share a traditional Moroccan dinner around the campfire, listen to Saharan music and drums, and enjoy the stars above the desert.

Overnight in a desert camp.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Erg Chigaga – Nomads & Camel Trekking
itinerary.description:
Wake up early to enjoy a beautiful sunrise over the Erg Chigaga dunes. After breakfast at the camp, begin a camel trek through the golden sands and discover the peaceful landscapes of the Sahara.

During the day, visit a local nomadic family and learn more about their traditional way of life, culture, and hospitality.

Enjoy a delicious Moroccan lunch, then take some time to relax at the camp, explore the dunes, or try sandboarding.

In the evening, watch another beautiful desert sunset before enjoying dinner around the campfire. Listen to Saharan music, share stories, and admire the clear starry sky in the silence of the Sahara.

Overnight in a desert camp.

itinerary.title: Erg Chigaga – Iriqui Lake – M’Hamid El Ghizlane
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, say goodbye to the desert camp and begin your journey back to M’Hamid El Ghizlane by 4x4.

Travel through Iriqui National Park and enjoy the wide, peaceful landscapes of the desert. Cross the dry bed of Iriqui Lake, an impressive area known for its unique scenery and desert wildlife.

Along the way, stop to take photos, enjoy a traditional tea, and appreciate the silence and beauty of the Sahara.

Continue towards M’Hamid El Ghizlane, arriving in the afternoon with unforgettable memories of the dunes, nomadic life, camel trekking, and peaceful desert nights.

items.subtitle: A 4x4 journey from Morocco's desert gateway to its wildest dunes
items.title: 3 Days Sahara Desert Tour from M'Hamid to Erg Chigaga
items.overview:
Join us for a 3-day desert adventure from M’Hamid to Erg Chigaga, where you can discover the beauty, silence, and simple life of the Moroccan Sahara.

The journey begins in M’Hamid, where you meet our local desert team and start your adventure by 4×4. We leave the roads behind and travel through wide desert landscapes, rocky plains, sandy areas, and small dunes on our way to the remote Erg Chigaga.

Once we reach the great dunes, the Sahara becomes your home. Take your time to walk in the sand, enjoy a traditional tea, climb the dunes, or simply sit and enjoy the peaceful desert around you. At sunset, experience a camel ride through the golden dunes and watch the sun disappear behind the horizon.

At the desert camp, enjoy a traditional Moroccan dinner prepared by our team. Later, gather around the fire, listen to Saharan music and stories, and enjoy the incredible night sky. Sleep comfortably in your private tent or choose to spend the night under the stars.

The next day gives you more time to discover the desert at a slower pace. Enjoy the sunrise, walk through the dunes, try sandboarding, relax at camp, or simply enjoy the silence of the Sahara.

On the final day, after breakfast, we begin our journey back to M’Hamid, crossing the desert once again and enjoying the landscapes along the way.

With us, the Sahara is not just a place to visit. It is a place to experience — with our local team, our traditions, and the peaceful rhythm of desert life.
included: camel rides at sunset and during trekking
2 nights in a luxury or standard desert camp
highlights: Sacred Oasis and Iriqui National Park

itinerary.title: Marrakech – High Atlas – Telouet – Ait Ben Haddou
itinerary.description:
Leave Marrakech at 09:30 in your private 4x4 and begin your journey through the High Atlas Mountains. Cross the Tizi n’Tichka Pass at around 2,260 metres, enjoying beautiful mountain views and traditional Berber villages along the way.

Continue towards the Telouet area, then follow the scenic Ounila Valley, passing through small villages, green valleys, and impressive mountain landscapes.

Arrive near Ait Ben Haddou, one of Morocco’s most famous historic ksars, and take time to explore the area.

In the evening, relax and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay in a traditional kasbah-style guesthouse near Ait Ben Haddou.

itinerary.title: Ait Ben Haddou – Foum Zguid – Iriqui National Park – Erg Chigaga
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, continue south through the beautiful landscapes of the Anti-Atlas Mountains, passing through Tazenakht and Foum Zguid.

From Foum Zguid, leave the paved road behind and begin an exciting 4x4 off-road adventure through Iriqui National Park. Cross the wide desert landscapes, passing the dry salt flats of Lake Iriqui and the rugged Madouar Mountains.

Continue deep into the Sahara until you reach the impressive Erg Chigaga dunes in the afternoon.

After arriving at the desert camp, enjoy a traditional mint tea and take some time to relax. Later, experience a camel ride across the golden dunes and climb one of the highest dunes to watch the beautiful Sahara sunset.

In the evening, enjoy a traditional Moroccan dinner around the campfire, listen to Saharan music, and admire the stars in the peaceful desert sky.

Overnight at the desert camp.

itinerary.title: Erg Chigaga – M’Hamid – Tamegroute – Zagora – Agdz
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, leave Erg Chigaga and travel back towards M’Hamid El Ghizlane by 4x4. Continue through Tamegroute and Zagora, following the beautiful Drâa Valley with its green palm groves, villages, and kasbahs.

Continue north towards Agdz, enjoying the changing landscapes along the way. Arrive in the afternoon and relax in a charming local guesthouse.

Overnight near Agdz.

Alternative: If you prefer more time in the Sahara, stay for a second night at Erg Chigaga. Enjoy a relaxed day in the dunes with free time for walking, camel riding, sandboarding, or simply enjoying the peaceful desert atmosphere.

Overnight at the desert camp

itinerary.title: Agdz – Ouarzazate – High Atlas – Marrakech
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, leave Agdz and begin your journey back to Marrakech. Travel through the beautiful Anti-Atlas Mountains, with impressive views of the High Atlas and the surrounding desert landscapes.

Continue towards Ouarzazate, passing the famous NOOR solar power complex, before crossing the High Atlas Mountains again via the Tizi n’Tichka Pass.

Enjoy the changing landscapes along the way, from desert valleys and mountains to traditional villages. Arrive in Marrakech in the afternoon, bringing your Sahara adventure to an end.

If you choose the second night in Erg Chigaga: After breakfast, leave the desert and travel by 4x4 through M’Hamid, Foum Zguid, and Ouarzazate before continuing to Marrakech. This is a longer travel day, with arrival usually in the late afternoon or early evening.

items.title: 4-Day Desert Tour from Marrakech to Erg Chigaga
items.overview:
Discover the beauty of Morocco on a private 4-day journey from Marrakech to the remote Erg Chigaga dunes and back.

Travel with your own local driver through the High Atlas Mountains, the beautiful Drâa Valley, and the wide landscapes of southern Morocco before reaching the peaceful Sahara.

Enjoy the journey in a private 4x4, with stops along the way to discover local villages, landscapes, and hidden places. In the desert, experience the golden dunes of Erg Chigaga, enjoy a camel ride at sunset, share traditional Moroccan food around the campfire, and spend the night under a sky full of stars.

This private experience is ideal for couples, families, and friends who want to discover the Sahara at their own pace.

Stay in comfortable local guesthouses and a traditional desert camp, with the option to add an extra night in the Sahara for more time to enjoy the desert.

A private journey through Morocco, from the mountains to the Sahara, with a local team and an authentic desert experience.

private travel with an English-speaking 4x4 driver

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate – Agdz – Zagora – Drâa Valley – M’Hamid
itinerary.description:
Start your adventure in the morning from Ouarzazate and travel south by 4x4 through the beautiful Anti-Atlas Mountains.

Continue to Agdz, then follow the Drâa Valley, famous for its green palm groves, traditional villages, and ancient kasbahs. Enjoy the changing landscapes as you travel deeper into southern Morocco.

Stop for lunch in Zagora before continuing towards M’Hamid El Ghizlane, the last village before the open Sahara.

From here, the paved road ends and the desert begins. Relax at your camp, enjoy a traditional dinner, and experience your first peaceful evening in the Sahara.

Accommodation: Desert camp with private tent and bathroom
Meals included: Dinner

itinerary.title: M’Hamid – Sacred Oasis – Erg Chigaga
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, leave M’Hamid and begin your 4x4 desert adventure across the open Sahara.

Travel off-road through rocky plains and sandy landscapes before stopping at the peaceful Sacred Oasis, a beautiful place surrounded by tamarisk trees in the middle of the desert.

Continue towards the impressive Erg Chigaga dunes, one of the most remote and spectacular dune areas in Morocco. Arrive at the camp in the afternoon and take some time to relax and enjoy the peaceful surroundings.

As the sun begins to set, enjoy a camel ride through the golden dunes and watch the desert change color.

In the evening, enjoy a traditional Moroccan dinner around the campfire, listen to Saharan music, and admire the stars far from city lights.

After breakfast, leave the desert by 4x4 and cross the wide, dry landscapes of Iriqui Lake, enjoying the peaceful scenery of the Sahara.

Continue to Foum Zguid, a small desert town, before heading towards Taznakht, famous for its traditional handmade Berber carpets. Stop here for lunch and take some time to discover the local area.

In the afternoon, continue your journey through the changing landscapes of southern Morocco and arrive back in Ouarzazate in the late afternoon.

items.title: 3 Day Sahara Desert Tour from Ouarzazate to Erg Chigaga
items.overview:
Join us for a 3-day journey from Ouarzazate to Erg Chigaga, traveling through the beautiful landscapes of southern Morocco and deep into the Sahara.

Our journey takes you through the Drâa Valley, palm groves, traditional villages, and ancient kasbahs before leaving the paved roads behind and heading towards the remote Erg Chigaga dunes.

Travel by private 4x4 with our local driver, enjoy the changing desert landscapes, and discover the Sahara at a relaxed pace.

At Erg Chigaga, experience the desert in a simple and authentic way. Ride a camel through the golden dunes at sunset, enjoy traditional Moroccan tea, and share dinner around the campfire while listening to Saharan music under the stars.

Wake up early to see the sunrise over the dunes, enjoy breakfast at the camp, and take time to walk, relax, or explore the desert before continuing your journey.

This tour is perfect for couples, families, and friends who want to discover the Sahara away from busy tourist places.

With Saharavacation, you don't just visit the desert — you experience it with our local team, our traditions, and the peaceful rhythm of Sahara life.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate – Taznakht – Foum Zguid – Iriqui Lake – Erg Chigaga
itinerary.description:
Start your desert adventure in the morning from Ouarzazate and travel towards Taznakht, passing through beautiful landscapes and traditional villages.

Continue towards Foum Zguid, following the road through a valley surrounded by palm trees. Stop in Foum Zguid for lunch before leaving the paved road and starting your 4x4 journey through the desert.

Cross the wide desert landscapes towards Iriqui Lake, a peaceful dry lake surrounded by open wilderness. Continue along the desert tracks until the first golden dunes of Erg Chigaga appear.

Arrive at your desert camp before sunset. Climb the dunes and enjoy a spectacular Sahara sunset over the endless sands.

In the evening, enjoy a traditional Moroccan dinner at the camp, followed by a peaceful night under the stars of the Sahara.

Accommodation: Desert camp
Meals included: Lunch, dinner

itinerary.title: Erg Chigaga – M’Hamid – Tamegroute – Zagora – Ouarzazate
itinerary.description:
Wake up early and enjoy the peaceful Sahara sunrise before breakfast at the camp.

After breakfast, take a short camel trek around the desert camp, then begin your journey back to M’Hamid El Ghizlane by 4x4. Cross the beautiful Hamada desert, passing sandy landscapes, small dunes, and desert oases along the way.

From M’Hamid, continue to Tamegroute, where you can visit its historic Quranic library and discover part of the cultural heritage of the Drâa Valley.

Continue to Zagora for lunch, then follow the palm-lined Drâa Valley towards Ouarzazate. Enjoy the changing landscapes, traditional villages, palm groves, and ancient kasbahs along the route.

Arrive in Ouarzazate in the afternoon, bringing your short but unforgettable Sahara adventure to an end.

Meals included: Breakfast, lunch

A short journey, but full of desert landscapes, local culture, camel trekking, and unforgettable moments in the heart of Morocco.

items.overview:
Discover the Wild Side of the Sahara

Looking for a short but unforgettable desert adventure? Our 2-day tour from Ouarzazate to Erg Chigaga takes you deep into the remote Sahara, far from the busy tourist routes.

Travel through the beautiful Drâa Valley, passing palm groves, desert villages, and wide open landscapes before leaving the paved roads behind. From M’Hamid, continue by 4x4 across the desert towards the impressive Erg Chigaga dunes.

Erg Chigaga is known for its remote location, peaceful atmosphere, and vast golden dunes. Here, you can enjoy the Sahara at its most natural and quiet, surrounded by endless sand and open skies.

At the dunes, experience a camel ride at sunset, enjoy traditional Moroccan tea, and spend the night in a desert camp. After dinner, gather around the campfire, listen to Saharan music, and look up at a sky full of stars.

The next morning, wake up to a beautiful desert sunrise, enjoy breakfast, and begin your journey back to Ouarzazate through the spectacular landscapes of the Sahara.

This is more than a quick desert trip. It is a short journey into the heart of the Sahara, created for travelers who want real desert landscapes, local culture, and peaceful moments far from the crowds.

itinerary.title: Agadir – Taroudant – Taliouine – Taznakht – Foum Zguid
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, leave Agadir and begin your journey towards southern Morocco.

Your first stop is Taroudant, a beautiful historic town surrounded by ancient walls and often called “Little Marrakech.” Take some time to explore its traditional streets and local atmosphere.

Continue towards Taliouine, famous for its high-quality saffron. Visit a local saffron cooperative and learn about this valuable Moroccan spice and how it is produced.

Continue through Taznakht, well known for its traditional handmade Berber carpets, before reaching Foum Zguid, a peaceful desert town and an important gateway to the Sahara.

Enjoy a relaxing evening and prepare for your desert adventure ahead.

Overnight: Hotel or guesthouse in Foum Zguid
Meals included: Dinner

itinerary.title: Foum Zguid – Iriqui Lake – Erg Chigaga
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, leave Foum Zguid and begin your 4x4 adventure into the Sahara. Leave the paved road behind and travel across wide desert plains and remote landscapes.

Cross the dry bed of Iriqui Lake, a peaceful and impressive desert area surrounded by open landscapes. Continue deeper into the Sahara until the golden dunes of Erg Chigaga appear.

Arrive at the desert camp in the afternoon and take some time to relax. As the sun begins to set, enjoy a camel ride through the dunes and watch the beautiful colors of the Sahara sunset.

In the evening, enjoy traditional Moroccan food and Saharan music around the campfire. Relax under the stars and experience the peaceful atmosphere of the desert.

Overnight: Desert camp in Erg Chigaga, standard or luxury option
Meals included: Breakfast, dinner

itinerary.title: Erg Chigaga – M’Hamid – Tamegroute – Zagora
itinerary.description:
Wake up early to enjoy a beautiful sunrise over the Erg Chigaga dunes. After breakfast, leave the desert camp and travel by 4x4 towards M’Hamid El Ghizlane, the last village before the open Sahara.

Continue to Tamegroute, a historic village famous for its traditional green pottery and ancient Quranic library. Take some time to discover its unique culture and local traditions.

Then continue through the palm-lined Drâa Valley to Zagora, an oasis town surrounded by date palms and desert landscapes.

Relax in the evening and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of the Drâa Valley.

Overnight: Riad or guesthouse in Zagora
Meals included: Breakfast, dinner

itinerary.title: Zagora – Agdz – Ait Ben Haddou – Ouarzazate
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, leave Zagora and follow the beautiful Drâa Valley, passing green palm groves, traditional villages, and ancient kasbahs along the way.

Continue towards Ait Ben Haddou, one of Morocco’s most famous historic ksars and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Take time to explore its narrow streets, old buildings, and impressive views of the surrounding landscape.

From Ait Ben Haddou, continue to Ouarzazate, known as the film capital of Morocco. Depending on your interests and time, you can visit Kasbah Taourirt or the Atlas Film Studios.

Enjoy a relaxing evening in Ouarzazate before continuing your journey back to Agadir.

Overnight: Hotel in Ouarzazate
Meals included: Breakfast, dinner

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate – Taznakht – Taliouine – Agadir
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, begin your journey back to Agadir, traveling through the beautiful landscapes of the Anti-Atlas Mountains.

Stop in Taznakht, famous for its traditional handmade Berber carpets and local crafts. Continue to Taliouine, Morocco’s famous saffron region, where you can discover local saffron products and traditional specialties.

Continue through the mountain landscapes and valleys towards Agadir, arriving in the late afternoon.

Your 5-day Sahara adventure comes to an end, leaving you with unforgettable memories of the desert, mountains, valleys, kasbahs, and local culture.

Meals included: Breakfast

Discover Morocco from the Mountains to the Sahara

Join us for a 5-day journey from Agadir to Erg Chigaga and discover the incredible variety of southern Morocco.

Travel through the Souss Valley, traditional Berber towns, ancient kasbahs, green palm oases, and dramatic mountain landscapes before reaching the wide open Sahara.

The highlight of the journey is Erg Chigaga, one of Morocco’s most remote and spectacular dune areas. Far from the busy tourist routes, you can experience the desert in a peaceful and authentic way.

Enjoy a 4x4 adventure across the desert, ride a camel through the golden dunes, watch the sunset from the sand, and spend the night in a traditional desert camp. In the evening, share a Moroccan dinner around the campfire, listen to Saharan music, and enjoy the stars above you.

This private journey is ideal for couples, families, friends, photographers, and adventure travelers who want to discover Morocco beyond the usual tourist routes.

From Agadir to the mountains, valleys, oases, and finally the Sahara  experience Morocco with our local team and discover the desert at your own pace.
